tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (17.4:1).

tokens.name: color-pow-red
tokens.usage: Action, energy, primary CTAs (8.2:1 contrast). Used as text on `.required-indicator`, `.form-error`. 3.8:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-kapow-yellow
tokens.usage: Attention, excitement, highlights (12.5:1). Used as shadow/glow on `.section-title`; text on `.footer-section-title`, `.footer-links a:hover`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-zoom-blue
tokens.usage: Trust, stability, links (6.8:1). Used as text on `.btn-secondary`; shadow/glow on `.btn-secondary`. 4.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-ink-black
tokens.usage: Outlines, text, depth (15.3:1). Used as text on `body`, `.company-name`, `.company-tagline`; shadow/glow on `.header`, `.nav a:hover`, `.nav a[aria-current="page"]`. 17.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-halftone-gray
